_meta.title: Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase II Trial of Fulvestrant (Faslodex) plus Everolimus in Post-Menopausal Patients with Hormone-Receptor Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer Resistant to Aromatase Inhibitor Therapy
_meta.scope: epochs, arms, elements, scheduleTimelines (including all ScheduledActivityInstance and ScheduledDecisionInstance entities), encounters, transitionRules. StudyIntervention, Activity, StudyCell, Population and Study wrapper entities are out of scope and are referenced by id only.
modelingNotes: Induction has a protocol-defined maximum of 12 28-day cycles, so Cycles 2-12 Day 1 are enumerated as explicit encounters (Encounter_4..14) and instances (ScheduledActivityInstance_4..14), each 28 days after the prior cycle (+/- 72 hours).

The Continuation Phase runs until progression or unacceptable toxicity with NO protocol-defined cycle count; it therefore cannot be enumerated and is modeled as a single repeating visit (Encounter_16 / ScheduledActivityInstance_16) that loops via ScheduledDecisionInstance_2.
Flow control uses ScheduledInstance.defaultConditionId for the linear path and ScheduledDecisionInstance conditionAssignments for the two branch points.
_meta.contentProvenance: All design content derived solely from the protocol PDF. CDISC Controlled Terminology codes are supplied from terminology knowledge (not stated in the protocol); see confidence notes.

epochs.name: SCREENING
epochs.label: Screening (Pre-Study)
epochs.description: Pre-study eligibility assessment performed within 4 weeks of randomization.

epochs.name: INDUCTION
epochs.label: Induction Phase
epochs.description: Fulvestrant plus everolimus or placebo for a maximum of 12 28-day cycles, until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

epochs.name: CONTINUATION
epochs.label: Continuation Phase
epochs.description: After 12 cycles without progression, patient is unblinded and continues fulvestrant alone (originally placebo) or with everolimus (originally everolimus) until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

epochs.name: FOLLOW_UP
epochs.label: Follow-Up Off-Therapy
epochs.description: All patients followed for 3 years from randomization for disease progression and survival; imaging every 3 months until documented progression.

arms.name: ARM A
arms.label: Arm A: Fulvestrant + Everolimus
arms.description: Fulvestrant 500 mg IM (two 250 mg injections) on Day 1 and Day 15 of Cycle 1, then 500 mg IM on Day 1 of all subsequent 28-day cycles, plus everolimus 10 mg (two 5 mg tablets) PO once daily.
arms.dataOriginDescription: Derived from protocol PrE0102 Schema and Section 5 Treatment Plan.

arms.name: ARM B
arms.label: Arm B: Fulvestrant + Placebo
arms.description: Fulvestrant 500 mg IM (two 250 mg injections) on Day 1 and Day 15 of Cycle 1, then 500 mg IM on Day 1 of all subsequent 28-day cycles, plus matching placebo (two tablets) PO once daily.
arms.dataOriginDescription: Derived from protocol PrE0102 Schema and Section 5 Treatment Plan.

conditionAssignments.condition: No evidence of disease progression after 12 cycles of Induction: patient is unblinded and proceeds to the Continuation Phase.
Disease progression or unacceptable toxicity (or other discontinuation per Sections 5.5/5.6): patient moves to Follow-Up Off-Therapy.
No documented progression and no unacceptable toxicity: continue treatment with the next Continuation cycle (this visit repeats; the protocol sets no fixed Continuation cycle count).
Documented disease progression or unacceptable toxicity: patient moves to Follow-Up Off-Therapy.
